مَفَرٌّ an inf. n. of فَرَّ. (S, M, K. [See the first and second sentences of this art.]) ―
-b2- Also A time [and a place] of fleeing: (TA:) and ↓ مَفِرُّ signifies a place of fleeing: (I'Ab, Zj, S, M, TA:) and so does ↓ مِفَرُّ ; (Zj, K, TA,) an instrumental noun used as a noun of place. (K, TA.) [See 1, second sentence.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
